en-US.description: Artha is a handy thesaurus based on WordNet.
en-US.longDescription: Artha is a handy thesaurus based on WordNet with distinct features like global hotkey look-up, passive desktop notifications, regular expression based search, etc. Artha may be used as a free open-source replacement to the proprietary WordWeb Pro.
en-US.name: Artha
